To hear the words of wisdom as they fell From lips inspired, and felt that life nor death. Nor all the powers combined of earth and hell Could never force my heart to turn aside From principles so holy and sublime.

opportunity to know it, will apply their hearts to this wisdom until
it becomes easy and familiar to them, and they will love to do good
instead of evil. 3:363.
